title: Product Manager
description:
About the Role
We are seeking a high-caliber Product Manager to join our Houzz Pro team. Houzz Pro is an all-in-one business management platform that helps professionals win projects, work with their clients and teams, and run their businesses efficiently and profitably.
In this role, you will turn complex operational workflows and business needs into intuitive product experiences that Pros rely on every day. You will own key areas of the product end to end, shaping strategy and leading execution. Working closely with other PMs, Engineering, Design, and Data, you will build scalable tools that power the end-to-end Houzz Pro ecosystem.

Houzz is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. When applying for a role at Houzz, we guarantee your application will be considered regardless of your sex; race; color; gender; national origin; height or weight; ancestry; physical or mental disability; medical condition; genetic information; marital status; registered domestic partner status; age; sexual orientation; military and veteran status; or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law or ordinance or regulation.

We embrace and celebrate the value that diversity brings to an organization. Diverse backgrounds and different points of view help Houzz provide the best experience for our community. Houzz is committed to fostering an inclusive environment through projects and initiatives, such as employee resource groups, that support Houzzers’ efforts to be themselves and share their lives at work.

If you would like assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at accommodations@houzz.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.

 
Houzz is an Equal Opportunity Employer. M/F/Disability/Veterans
__________________

Be Who You Are and Do What You Love at Houzz 

About Houzz
When founders Adi and Alon remodeled their home, they were frustrated by the lack of resources and inspiration to help them articulate a vision and select the right pro to make it a reality. 

So they built Houzz. 

Houzz is now the leading platform for home remodeling and design, providing an all-in-one software solution for industry professionals and tools for homeowners to update their homes from start to finish. Using Houzz, people can find ideas and inspiration, hire professionals, and shop for products. Houzz Pro (houzz.com/pro) provides home industry professionals with a business management and marketing SaaS solution that helps them to win projects, collaborate with clients and teams, and run their business efficiently and profitably. 

Our Mission and Core Values
We're proud to say there's no one quite like us. Houzz is a community-centric, innovative tech company that continues to disrupt the home renovation and design industry. Our mission-driven culture is rooted in our core values, and we’re all here for one purpose: make the home remodeling and design process more fun and productive for everyone. 

Our Mission
To create the best experience for home renovation and design.

Our Core Values
We’re a Community
We put our community of Houzzers, industry professionals and homeowners first. We approach our work with care, humility and respect. We deliver value to our community through our products and services.

We Build the Future
We are visionaries who challenge the status quo. We are creative, innovative and curious. We embrace change and different ideas to drive our industry forward. 

We Make Things Happen
We are solution-seekers and self-starters. We listen, move fast and empower our teams to deliver extraordinary results and products. We play to win.
 

By applying for a job with us, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: シニア テクニカルサポートエンジニア — 日本（リモート、東京への出張あり）
description:
日本語訳

募集地域について
本ポジションは日本での採用です。オフィス勤務ではないため、日本国内であればお住まいの地域は問いません。渋谷(東京)にオフィスがあり、東京在住の方が望ましいですが、必須ではありません。

担当する業務
ClickHouseでは現在、世界中のお客様に優れたサービスを提供するサポートチームを拡大しています。日本国内のお客様はもちろん、APJおよびEMEA地域にまたがるお客様に関する幅広い業務に取り組んでいただける方を探しています。本ポジションはお客様と直接やり取りする職種で、日本国内でのお客様先への訪問も一部含まれます。サポートチケットやコミュニティサポートに加え、プリセールス・ポストセールス双方のお客様向け活動の支援、Go To Marketチームと連携したPOCの高度な技術面への対応、ClickHouseのサポート部門における業務改善の提案など、幅広い業務を主体的に担当していただきます。自ら率先して手を動かし、日本での地域プレゼンスの拡大に貢献したい方にとって、またとない機会です。

参画いただく可能性のあるプロジェクト例

- サポートサービスチーム、エンジニアリング、プロダクトマネジメントと緊密に連携し、ユーザーやお客様に必要とされる機能の定義に貢献する

- ClickHouse CloudおよびClickHouseオープンソースをベースとしたソリューションを開発し、ドキュメント、ナレッジベース、ブログ、ミートアップ、ウェビナー、トレーニングを通じて、ユーザー、コミュニティ、お客様と共有する

- 同僚、ユーザー、お客様に対するメンタリングやトレーニング、知識の共有を支援する

そして、もちろん以下も担います

- フロントラインのエンジニア、そしてClickHouseの代表として、優れたカスタマーサービスを提供します。当社のサポートエンジニアは、チケットシステム、メール、Slack、電話などで受け付けた技術的なケースに対し、所定のサービスレベルアグリーメント(「SLA」)の範囲内で、プロフェッショナルな対応、オンコール対応、およびガイダンスを提供します

- 同僚、お客様、パートナーとの間に、強固で信頼できる関係を築きます

求めるスキル・経験

- テクニカルサポート組織での実務経験

- 関連分野における幅広く深い技術力(例:ClickHouse DBMS、または類似のOLAP/SQLデータベース、クラウド/SaaSプラットフォームの経験、Linux/Unixの経験、Kubernetesおよびコンテナの経験、システムまたはネットワーク管理の経験)

- グローバルに分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要な、勤務スケジュールおよび出張(現地訪問)に対応でき、対応可能であること

- 日本語と英語の両方における優れた文章力・会話力

- プリセールス・ポストセールスのサポート、ソリューションエンジニアリングまたはセールスエンジニアリング、コンサルティング、トレーニングなどを伴う、顧客対応職での経験

- チームワーク、グローバルな視点での関わり、共感力、そして困難な課題を解決する姿勢

- 世界で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能かつ最大規模、最速のデータベースを構築することに対する冒険心と切迫感

- 自発的で好奇心旺盛、継続的に学び成長する意欲があること

あればなお歓迎

- ソフトウェア開発者、プロダクトマネージャー、アカウント担当者、ユーザーコミュニティと協力し、素晴らしいユーザー体験・顧客体験を実現した実績

- オープンソースのソフトウェア技術を大規模なデータセットに適用し、複雑な問いを解決して私たちの暮らす世界をより良くしたいという情熱

確認・調整メモ

- 原文の軽微な修正点(英語側): 「locared」は「located」の誤記と解釈しました。また「support team … who provides」は、チームなので「that provides」が自然です。

- 「24x7」: 日本語では「24時間365日」が一般的なため、この表現にしました。原文どおり「24x7」のままにしたい場合はお知らせください。

- 「Be present and available…」: 他の箇条書きが名詞句なのに対し、この項目だけ命令形で並列が崩れています。日本語では「〜に対応でき、対応可能であること」と、他項目に合わせた形にしました。

- 「アカウント担当者」: account representativesの訳です。社内で「アカウントエグゼクティブ」など特定の呼称があれば、それに置き換えてください。

- 敬体について: 「担当する業務」セクションは、ですます調で統一しています。日本語のJDでは一般的な文体です。

 

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

JLL is seeking an experienced Senior High Voltage Electrical Engineer to lead the design and engineering of critical electrical infrastructure for hyperscale data centers and mission-critical facilities. This role provides technical leadership for complex capital projects involving high voltage electrical systems, utility-scale substations, on-site generation, and renewable energy integration.
You will serve as the technical authority on data center electrical infrastructure projects, leading system architecture development, utility coordination, and engineering oversight from concept through commissioning. title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.
Summary

In this role, you’ll own the technical and functional win across a high-volume SMB sales motion. You’ll partner closely with a team of account executives, along with Product and Professional Services, to support fast-moving, transactional sales cycles across multiple product lines.

Success in this role requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is comfortable delivering frequent, repeatable product demonstrations while maintaining a high standard of quality and customer engagement. Beyond supporting active opportunities, you’ll help strengthen a growing sales team by providing ongoing enablement, refining repeatable processes, and identifying ways to make the sales motion more efficient and scalable. This may include expanding the use of external demo-library tools, leveraging AI to develop new workflows, and finding creative ways to automate or streamline repetitive work.

How will you contribute?

• Spend 50-70% of your time working on revenue generating deals, with the remaining time spent on supporting our internal projects, ongoing learning, and supporting cross-departmental initiatives as needed.

• Assist sales with discovery process to identify quantifiable problems our solutions can solve

• Demonstrate/Workshop/Solution how our products/platform can help our prospects/customers achieve their desired business outcomes and realize value

• Lead the scoping and execution of validation events where appropriate

• Take the lead on the technical responses associated with an RFI/RFP/RFQ/Infosec etc.

• Regularly update systems of record (salesforce, SharePoint etc.) with presales notes/collateral etc.

• Contribute best practices and content/collateral to broader presales and sales teams

• Present professional services and success management offerings as part of a comprehensive solution

• Support cross-departmental projects like lead generation, event marketing, partner enablement, and sales enablement as needed

• Travel as needed for internal/external meetings

What will you bring?

• Familiarity with or hands on experience using the Smarsh suite of products, OR 1-2 years of solution engineering experience

• An ability to demonstrate our products in a way to sells the value of our solutions aligned to a client’s business objectives and pain points

• Domain knowledge of the Compliance or IT space

• Strong presentation skills to both executives and practitioners

• Knowledge and ability to present/demonstrate business processes/workflows associated with compliance (capture/archive/surveillance) use-cases

• Experience working in the Financial Services, Cyber Compliance or other SEC/FINRA-Regulated domains.

• Solution Selling, Demo2Win, and MEDDIC/MEDDPICC experience

• Strategic Thinking and a problem-solving mindset

• Operates with a high degree of independence and accountability, taking initiative to address gaps in preparation, communication, follow-through, and sales partnership before escalating for support.

• Recommended Traits: Curiosity, effective time management, strong collaborative spirit, detail oriented, work with a sense of urgency, strong work ethic and an empathetic attitude

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent educational experience

• Experience in SaaS a plus

title: Customer Service Specialist - GA
description:
This is a remote position.
We are looking for energetic individuals that have an interest in providing our clients/customers with excellent customer service from your secured home office.
​
Requirements

• Must speak English fluently.

• Be able to type 40 words per minute or greater;

• High-speed DSL or cable connection rated at least 10 MB download speed and 2 MB upload speed.

• Dedicated home office space, which is free from distraction, and with a door that can be closed and locked. We will ask you to provide a picture of this space. Your workspace must be a dedicated working environment that is used exclusively by you.

• A personal desktop computer running a licensed version of Windows 10 or higher (Windows 11 preferred), with 8 GB of RAM (Core i3 processor, or better). Laptops are not eligible for the work-at-home agent program.

• A 19″ flat panel monitor (minimum), multiple displays recommended and preferred.

• A webcam, for training, compliance, and collaboration purposes.

• A wired network connection (wireless is not permitted).

• An approved-brand USB headset for VOIP

• A modern mobile phone (iOS or Android) that can be used for multi-factor authentication purposes. Must have iOS 17 or greater, or Android OS 12 or greater. Apple or Samsung brand preferred.

Benefits

Everyone needs time to relax and enjoy life - and at XACT , we’re firm believers in work-life balance. Our paid time off (PTO) program allows team members to earn time they can use to unwind and enjoy life outside of work.

Although we’re open 24 hours a day, we believe in flexible scheduling that integrates work into your life - not the other way around. Set schedules, split shifts, and on-demand shift availability are just a few of the options we offer.

Full-time team members are eligible to join our company group plan through Aetna, once eligibility requirements are met.

Smile confidently!

XACT offers dental insurance through Sun Life to eligible team members. With both low- and high-benefit plan options, you’ll find one that fits your needs and makes you grin.

We see you, too!

We proudly offer VSP vision insurance to eligible team members. With strong coverage and savings on glasses and contacts, it's easy to see the value.

In addition to standard insurance options, we also provide supplemental products through Allstate - including accident, disability, and other coverage choices.

Relax - it’s expected.

We’re happy to provide safe, comfortable working environments designed with your well-being in mind. Our call centers feature employee lounges, quiet spaces, and cozy places to work.

We’re just one big family here, so pull up a seat and join in. As a team member - not an independent contractor - you can count on us for support. Whether you’re working in our contact centers or from your home office, we’ll equip you with the tools, technology, and 24×7 support you need to succeed.

title: Commercial Account Executive - India
description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

Location Preference: Remote, Must be based in India as travel may be required to visit clients on site.

About The Role:

We are looking for an India-based Commercial Account Executive to deliver new revenue within the APAC region. This is an outside sales position responsible for developing pipeline, managing opportunities and closing business. The role is responsible for driving the sales cycle from prospect to initial close and then work with Customer Success to continue to drive growth from the account.

Responsibilities:

• You will establish, handle, and manage relationships between Fingerprint and senior executives of the client and prospect companies

• Establish an understanding of the customer's Founder/CxO key business initiatives/objectives and present how our platform can help them achieve their goals

• Make sales presentations to customers and prospects at all levels

• Value-based selling (prospecting/lead generation, qualification and scoping, closing strategies, negotiations, etc.);

• Interface and develop professional relationships with clients and prospects throughout the organizational levels;

• In collaboration with Fingerprint s’ marketing team, develop and execute demand generation campaigns;

• Coordinate and actively participate in contract negotiations;

• Act as representative of Fingerprint at industry conferences and association meetings;

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of Fingerprint s’ solution offerings;

• Maintain a real-time understanding of the competitive landscape to assist in figuring out win-based proposals and pricing;

• Meet or exceed quota expectations;

Qualifications:

• 5-6 years of B2B Sales experience. SaaS and/or Series C+ Startup Experience is a positive

• Must be located in India

• Role requires proficiency with macOS and comfort working fully remotely using tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom.

• Experience selling a developer-focused product where engineering and/or product leadership owns the buying power

• Proven track record of consistent success in closing Commercial Deals, ideally in fraud / cybersecurity or IAM

title: VP of Product
description:
About Augintel : We exist to give child welfare leadership and staff a deeper understanding of the people they care for. By building SaaS software applications that apply cutting-edge artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques, we help clinicians in social services, behavioral health and child welfare - government, private and nonprofit - unlock the value of their unstructured data to improve their understanding, save them time, and help them deliver better outcomes to the people and communities they serve.

Location: Remote (US). Ability to support customers across multiple time zones is required.

Reports To: CEO

Job Summary:

Over the last six years Augintel has built a new category in Child Welfare and has transformed how caseworkers and supervisors do their jobs. We’ve been first to market with an industry-defining product, enjoy exceptional customer retention, and continue to win new business. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need to strengthen both our strategic vision as well as our day-to-day execution.

The Chief Product Officer will be the executive responsible for aligning Augintel ’s strategy and product direction and associated operating cadence and cross-functional execution.

This leader will help Augintel maintain the speed and customer intimacy of a founder-led company while building the clarity, accountability, prioritization discipline, and operating infrastructure required for sustainable growth.

At the product level, this leader will own the translation of Augintel ’s vision into a cohesive 12-36 month product strategy and roadmap. They will ensure that new products and features do not simply ship, but land in the market with clear positioning, customer value, adoption plans, enablement, and measurable revenue impact.

At the operating level, this leader will build the company-wide rhythms that connect annual strategy to quarterly execution, commitments to operating plans, and customer commitments to product, engineering, and commercial capacity.

The right person is both strategic and hands-on. They can articulate a compelling multi-year product vision, but they also care deeply about roadmap discipline, prioritization, launch quality, customer feedback loops, commercial enablement, financial outcomes, and execution predictability.

The ideal candidate thrives in founder-led organizations transitioning from early-stage success to operational maturity. They excel at balancing customer commitments with long-term strategic investments and are energized by solving complex scaling challenges.

This is a role for a builder, operator, product strategist, and trusted CEO partner. This role is part of the executive team and reports to the CEO.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Operating Rhythm & Execution

• Translate annual strategic product objectives into measurable quarterly execution

• Lead company-wide planning processes, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, and operating reviews

• Establish and maintain a consistent cadence of product and go-to-market execution and accountability across the organization

• Monitor progress against company objectives and proactively identify execution risks

Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership

• Own Augintel ’s product strategy in partnership with the CEO, Engineering, Revenue, Marketing and Customer Impact

• Translate CEO vision and market insight into a cohesive 12-36 month product roadmap

• Balance near-term customer commitments with long-term strategic product investments

• Ensure roadmap decisions are grounded in customer value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and time-to-market

• Establish clear prioritization frameworks that guide what Augintel starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes

• Elevate product discovery, customer understanding, design discipline, experimentation, and product decision-making across the company

• Represent Product at the executive and board level

title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Research, World Action Model
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Research, implement, and evaluate world action models for end-to-end autonomous driving

• Collaborate with research and engineering teams to improve the Waymo World Model

• Conduct cutting-edge research and potentially communicate research findings to the wider academic community via technical reports and/or publication

 

You have:

• Currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• Strong publication record in top-tier AI/ML or robotics conferences

• Hands-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for autonomous driving or robotics applications

• Strong Python coding skills with expertise in modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)

• Deep understanding of modern neural network architectures and learning paradigms

 

We prefer:

• Experience with diffusion / flow matching models

• Experience with world action models in autonomous driving or robotics applications

• Familiarity with autonomous driving datasets

• Experience with open-source foundation models

 

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.

Hourly PhD Pay
$85 — $85 USD

⌘ About you

• Strong interaction and visual design. Knows when to polish and when to ship.

• Proficiency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, and comfort working across multiple levels of fidelity - from early concepts to polished, production-ready designs.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with product managers and engineers, taking ownership while working toward shared outcomes.

• Experience using AI tools to support design workflows and ideation, with curiosity about how AI can responsibly enhance product design.

• A clear, empathetic communicator who can give and receive feedback constructively and contribute to a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

• Background in social, dating, community, or marketplace consumer products.

title: Staff Controls Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Motor Control Algorithm Development
•       Design and implement field-oriented control (FOC), six-step commutation, and direct torque control algorithms for BLDC and PMSM motors
•       Develop sensorless rotor position estimation techniques (back-EMF observer, sliding-mode observer, high-frequency injection) for applications where Hall sensors or encoders are not viable
•       Design current, speed, and position control loops with rigorous bandwidth, stability margins, and disturbance rejection specifications
Modelling & Simulation (MIL / SIL / HIL)
•       Build high-fidelity motor and inverter plant models in MATLAB / Simulink, including magnetic saturation, iron losses, and thermal coupling
•       Develop controller models and validate performance through Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) simulation against requirements
•       Execute Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing using Embedded Coder auto-generated C code to verify fixed-point scaling, quantisation effects, and code-generation fidelity
•       Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) integration with real-time simulators (dSPACE, Typhoon HIL, or equivalent) for full controller board validation
•       Integrate Simulink auto-coded algorithm modules with the microcontroller RTOS, peripheral drivers, and application framework
Firmware & Embedded Systems
•       Implement motor control firmware in C on microcontrollers (e.g., STM32, TI C2000, NXP S32K) with hard real-time constraints
•       Configure and optimise motor control peripherals: PWM timers, ADC synchronisation, encoder/Hall interfaces, comparator-based overcurrent protection
•       Architect firmware for deterministic control loop execution - interrupt prioritisation, DMA pipelines, and minimal-jitter scheduling
•       Implement fault detection, diagnosis, and safe-state management in firmware (overcurrent, overvoltage, overtemperature, sensor loss, stall, phase loss)
•       Develop communication interfaces (CAN, SPI, UART, RS-485) for command, telemetry, and diagnostics

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

•       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience
•       10+ years of professional experience designing and implementing motor control algorithms (FOC, Trapezoidal, or equivalent) for BLDC or PMSM motors
•       Strong foundation in classical and modern control theory - PID tuning, frequency-domain analysis, state estimation, observer design
•       Proficiency in MATLAB / Simulink, PLEC

title: [MSO] Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer (Ansible)
description:
Project - the aim you’ll have
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer to help build an automation practice for a leading IT infrastructure provider in the Netherlands.

Automation is already being done, but it has grown in several directions at once - different approaches, different standards and different repository layouts running in parallel. A large part of this role is bringing that together into one practice the whole team works with.

You will join a 12+ person Polish engineering team responsible for maintaining the client's Linux and Windows estate and for delivering transformation projects on it. The environment carries a significant legacy footprint, built up over years of operations. At the same time we are building a completely new platform based on OpenStack, so the automation you create will cover both: keeping the existing estate running, and making sure the new platform is automated from day one rather than years later.

You will also have a software development team as a help, so when something needs to be properly engineered rather than scripted around, you will not be solving it alone.

Your first deliverable is continuous patching across Linux and Windows - moving the client from scheduled manual patching cycles to an automated, continuously running process. From there the practice expands into deployment automation, configuration management and process automation across the estate.
Role - how you’ll contribute

• Writing Ansible automation - playbooks, roles, modules and collections - this is the core, day-to-day work of the role

• Help shape the automation practice: standards, repository structure and code review process, worked out together with the team

• Patch management automation

• Deployment automation

• Configuration management

• Systems and process automation

• Project-driven infrastructure transformations - bring automation into the transformation projects the team delivers, so that what is built new is automated from the start

• Support, configure and manage the automation platform

• Automation-related code review and maintenance across the team

• CI/CD configuration and management for automation code

• Define and maintain the inventory and source of truth the automation runs against

• Introduce testing for automation code, so changes can be released to a production estate with confidence

• Work with engineers maintaining the estate to identify what should be automated next, and in what order

• Share knowledge with the team so the practice is something everyone can work with

• Produce and maintain the technical documentation that makes the practice usable by others

Expectations - the experience you need

• Advanced knowledge and experience in using, configuring and maintaining automation platforms, preferably AAP/AWX

• Understanding best practices for writing and maintaining Ansible code and repositories

• Developing Ansible playbooks, roles and modules; maintaining Ansible collections

• Using Ansible to manage systems and processes at scale

• Advanced understanding of IaC principles

• Practical experience with patch management across both Linux and Windows systems

• Experience working across various Linux distributions

• Programming skills, preferably Python

• Solid Git and version control practice applied to automation code

• Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation

• English at C1 level - the working language with the client, including direct contact with client-side engineers and stakeholders

Additional skills - the edge you have

• OpenStack - we are building a new platform on it, so experience here is a strong plus

• Experience consolidating scattered automation into a single, consistent practice

• Experience setting technical standards and getting a team to adopt them

• Good understanding of virtualization concepts

• Puppet - part of the current estate, and consolidating it into Ansible is within the scope of this rol

title: Supply and Demand Planner
description:
The Role

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team in Inoza Tower, BGC that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility in getting the right products to our members at the right time. You’ll own our robust short and long-range forecasts and demand plans, bringing together seasonal patterns, customer trends and upcoming marketing activity to determine optimal purchasing volumes across all of our product types.

You’ll build the long-term view of our monthly themes, finding smart ways to put excess legacy kits and theme stock to good use where appropriate. From there, you’ll break that plan down into full theme forecasts and fortnightly production plans, agreed with our 3PL partner.

You’ll also be the go-to person for stock reporting, reconciling our internal view of stock against supplier stock levels, taking into account both regular reporting and every stock movement, so the business always has an accurate picture.

Great communication is key to success in this role. You’ll work closely with your own team and the wider business, bringing data to life through clear, visual reporting that gives everyone complete transparency.

Working alongside our Supply Chain Director and Operations Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we plan, driving improvements in forecasting accuracy and building processes that reduce excess stock and risk. Contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What you’ll do

Planning & Forecasting:

• Taking account of current and future stock, create and implement short, full-theme and long- range forecasts and demand plans.

• Collaborate with the marketing team to understand their plans and objectives and reflect these in forecasting.

The Director will work closely with the internal audit department and be a primary contact for the Company’s external auditors. The role will also be a key partner to peers within Oklo’s finance team and across the organization, providing internal training and education on areas of accounting impacting Oklo today and in the future. This role will be a key resource to Corporate Development, Procurement and Business Unit Leaders, providing expert accounting advice as contracts and other transactions are being structured. The Director will play a critical role in optimizing Oklo’s accounting processes, policies and reporting, enabling the business to grow at pace.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Prepare the financial statements and footnotes for Oklo’s Form 10-K and Form 10-Q, including all supporting schedules, and related reporting packages. Partner with key stakeholders across the Company to prepare the MD&A.

• Lead Disclosure Committee meetings and assist the VP of Accounting and Controller in the preparation of Audit Committee reports.

• Perform technical accounting research on complex areas of accounting relevant to Oklo, including business combinations and asset acquisitions, power purchase agreements, consolidation and equity method accounting, financial investments, stock-based compensation, and capitalization of construction costs.

• Lead the adoption of any new Accounting Standards and Accounting Standard Updates, including project management and reporting progress to senior management. Monitor developments at the FASB as it relates to potential new standards,

• Serve as key contact for the Company’s external auditors, ensuring strong project management over all phases of the audit and identifying any areas for continuous improvement.

• Own the Company’s suite of accounting policies and lead the development of new policies as the Company expands and new business transactions are executed.

• Own SOX controls in the areas of SEC reporting and technical accounting, preparing robust documentation to support ICFR certifications and the external SOX audit.

• Coach and develop the team, identify appropriate training and development opportunities for each team member, and lead organization-wide training on key accounting and reporting topics.

• Monitor developments at the SEC and any rule changes that may impact Oklo’s filing requirements. Partner with Legal and Compliance on all SEC-reporting matters.

• Develop accounting playbooks to educate and support the organization on key areas of accounting impacting Oklo.

• Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, workpapers, and controls to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

• Partner with the Process and Systems team to identify AI implementation opportunities that would enhance Oklo’s financial reporting and technical accounting functions.

• Partner with Accounting Operations to ensure transactions are accounted for accurately and in a timely manner and G/L architecture is optimally designed to streamline SEC reporting.

• Partner with the FP&A team to ensure internal forecasts accurately reflect the accounting for significant new transactions.

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.

2. AI-Enabled, Human Human Centered - using AI to make support meaningfully more efficient and more human at the same time

title: Security GRC Manager
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your mission

Teya is a regulated payments fintech serving small businesses across Europe. Security, audit and regulatory trust are what keep our licences, card-scheme access and market access. Security at Teya is three connected teams: Security Engineering builds and runs technical controls, Security Operations runs monitoring and incident response, and Security GRC owns policy, risk and regulatory alignment.

As Security GRC Manager, reporting to the CISO, you will lead a team of three that turns PCI DSS, SWIFT CSP, ISO 27001, PCI PIN, PCI MPoC and UK and EU regulation into clear, engineer-able and increasingly automated ways of working. The function is mid-transformation. Vanta is being rolled out, the risk approach is being redefined, findings are being consolidated and third-party risk is being rebuilt with Procurement. Your job is to finish that shift, make it stick, and make GRC an accelerator for engineering rather than a toll gate. For the next two to three years, the priority is PCI DSS and SWIFT CSP excellence, built to scale towards the expectations of a regulated UK and European financial entity.

Responsibilities

- Lead and develop the Security GRC team, running a two-week sprint cadence and balancing roadmap work against heavy unplanned demand

- Represent Security GRC to auditors, assessors, regulators, the CISO and senior stakeholders

- Lead UK regulatory coverage, including operational resilience and FCA expectations, partnering with the team’s GRC Lead for EU regulation and DORA

- Own the ISMS policies and build one mapped control set across all frameworks, so teams get one evidence request instead of several

- Own the security risk methodology, scenario library and risk register, working with 2nd-line Risk and the OpRes and DORA programmes

- Run third-party security assessments with Procurement, Privacy and Legal, including the exceptions and risk acceptance path

- Plan the annual audit programme and lead PCI DSS (with the QSA) and SWIFT CSP assessments

- Own the consolidated findings register so issues are closed, not re-raised audit after audit

- Make Vanta the source of truth for evidence and lead governed automation of control assurance, including AI-assisted evidence review with named human owners

- Own the Significant Change procedure for PCI-scoped changes and oversee access and joiner-mover-leaver controls

- Report GRC metrics, risks and audit status to Security leadership

Requirements

- 7+ years in information security, with substantial GRC leadership in regulated financial services; UK banking or payments strongly preferred

- Hands-on ownership of a PCI DSS or equivalent programme, including the QSA relationship and Report on Compliance end to end

- Experience of UK regulation, including operational resilience, and ideally a regulatory authorisation or supervisory review

- A track record of designing and running a security risk register, governance forum and third-party security risk programme

title: Regional Sales Manager, North America
description:
Sell Sweetspot to golf venues across North America, then stay with them as their main contact for the long run. Full-cycle sales and account ownership in one role, as one of our first hires in North America.
About Sweetspot
We make golf more valuable - to the player who shows up, the operator who runs the venue, and the game itself. It's the test we hold everything we build to.
Sweetspot is the commercial platform for modern golf facilities: bookings, payments, memberships, dynamic pricing, POS, the player app, revenue management agents and the reporting that finally tells an operator what all of it earns. We build for the facility because that's where golf actually happens. When a venue knows its players, it can give every one of them a reason to come back, and that's how the game grows. Golf will never be worth enough, so we'll never be done.
500+ facilities in 20 countries, built in Sweden - and North America is where we're growing fastest. This is one of the first hires on the ground, so you won't inherit a playbook. You'll write it with us, and every venue you sign is one more place where golf is worth more than it was the year before.
The opportunity
Most range and simulator operators here can't answer the question their business rests on: what is an hour of bay time worth, and when? They price the same bucket at 7am Tuesday as at 6pm Friday. They don't know which bays sit cold or which members quietly stopped coming. The data exists - it's just scattered across a booking tool, a POS, a Toptracer bay and somebody's spreadsheet, none of which talk.
We put it in one place and then do something with it: pricing that fills the cold hours, memberships that make revenue forecastable, utilization and yield reported per bay and per hour. It isn't a software sale. You show an owner what their venue could earn, then stay and make it happen.
What we believe about the relationship
Golf is a small industry and it runs on people. An operator who bought from you does not want to be handed to a stranger the week after go-live - so we don't do that. You keep your customers. You sign them, you see them through the switch, and you're still the name in their phone two years later when they're opening a second site.
That's a deliberate choice. It costs more per rep and it means we hire people who can do both halves of the job. It's also why our customers stay, and why they take our call when we have something new to sell them.
The job

• Find the opportunities. Roughly 70% of your week. Your own pipeline, your own demos, your own closes. Nobody hands you leads.

• Own the partner relationships. Toptracer and Range Servant are how much of this market gets built. Be the person their people in your territory actually call - joint visits, shared prospects, and enough standing with them to open doors we'd never open cold. This is your path to high velocity from Day 1.

• Get customers through the transition. Switching systems is the scariest thing an operator does all year. You own the commercial side of go-live and you train their team yourself. Our Support team takes configuration, migration and the ticket queue, so your time goes into the relationship.

• Don't be a stranger. Regular contact, on site, with their numbers in hand - what's underpriced, which hours are cold, which members drifted. Show up before they need you, not after.

• Sell the whole portfolio. Then come back and grow them: memberships, dynamic pricing, vouchers, POS, Pay & Dispense, the app, the second site. Expansion sits in your number, not somebody else's.

Who you are

• Well-connected in golf where you live. Range owners, simulator operators, academy directors - by first name.

• A closer. Full-cycle B2B with multiple stakeholders and an install at the end.

• Comfortable in the numbers. You can build the payback case in front of an owner and defend it without a spreadsheet to hide behind.

• Someone who wants to own customers, not just deals. You'd rather have twenty o

title: Product Manager, Impact Platform & Experimentation
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Join the Experimentation & Impact Platform at Vinted. We are two closely linked teams in Data Infrastructure that build the internal products Vinted uses to ship features safely and make decisions based on evidence. Teams across Marketplace, Vinted Go and Vinted Pay use our tools. Product, Engineering, Data and Design people use them every day to roll out features, run experiments and understand impact.

• Impact Platform builds Impact, our self-service feature-flag and experimentation platform. That includes SDKs for Ruby, JavaScript, Go, iOS and Android, the backend services, and the Impact web UI. Impact handles about 20 million flag evaluations per second.

• Experimentation builds the standardised metrics framework and automated experiment analysis pipelines. It also owns cumulative impact reporting, which tracks the observed effect of shipped work across 17 key business metrics and feeds into Marketplace planning. The team also creates educational material and helps with complex analysis cases.

title: Senior Manager, Deal Desk
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is hiring a Senior Manager, Deal Desk to build our deal desk from the ground up and run it. Deepgram is a usage-based voice AI platform (speech-to-text, text-to-speech and the Voice Agent API), sold through self-serve plans, enterprise commitments and cloud marketplaces. You'll report to the Chief Accounting Officer and work daily with leaders in Sales, Customer Success, Product and Finance.

The desk is not a control function. Its job is to help Sales win better deals faster, at prices we can defend.

What you'll do

- Build the desk: approval matrix, pre-approved playbook, and credit and promo guidelines, so most deals need no approval.

- Run it day to day: review non-standard deals and give same-day answers.

- Shape large deals early: commitment size, ramps, product mix and terms.

- Partner with Product and sales leadership on pricing and packaging.

- Build pricing insight: deal margin, realized discount, and win rate by discount band.

- Keep deals clean and audit-ready, with approvals and terms recorded in Salesforce.

- Use AI to run the desk: an agent does the first-pass review; you make the call and improve the rules.

- Build out CPQ in Salesforce so the playbook and approvals live in the quote.

- Partner with Customer Success on renewals at first, then take ownership of renewals as the desk matures.

What you'll need

- 6+ years in deal desk, deal strategy or pricing at a B2B technology company, with 3+ running a desk.

- Usage-based pricing experience: commitments, credits, overage, ramps and rollover.

- A desk, matrix or playbook you built that sales adopted.

- Financial fluency, including how deal terms affect revenue recognition.

- Hands-on experience building Salesforce CPQ, plus SQL.

- Credibility with sales executives, clear writing, and an AI-native way of working you can show.

Nice to have

- Infrastructure, API or AI company experience.

- Pre-IPO experience.

- Cloud marketplace private offers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

- Has owned or run renewals.

Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team:

The Email team owns the Email platform behind HighLevel 's email experience, which powers 40M+ emails a day. We own the full path from compose to inbox, so the reliability, speed and quality of what we ship directly decide whether emails from over a million businesses land in the inbox.

We are responsible for:

• Email Platform: The Vue.js apps used to design, compose and send emails, plus the Node.js/NestJS services behind them.

• Sending Infrastructure & Deliverability: IP pools, dedicated IPs, dedicated domains and shared domain pools. These let new users send from day one, while we stay accountable for getting their email into the inbox.

• API-First Platform: Every capability is exposed through APIs, so email can be built into any product or workflow that needs it.

• Scale & Reliability: Keeping throughput high at peak load, with high uptime and send success rates.

• Email Statistics & Analytics: Integrating email stats with internal teams and making every release measurable on our dashboards.

• AI in Email: Bringing LLM-powered capabilities into email creation, while weighing token cost, latency and quality

Impact & Scale

Email is one of the most critical channels on HighLevel . When it works, businesses grow; when it breaks, their customers stop hearing from them. That's the weight this role carries.

• Businesses: Every one of the 1M+ businesses on HighLevel relies on email to reach their customers.

• Sub-accounts: Your work runs across 1.6M+ sub-accounts, from solo operators to agencies managing hundreds of clients.

• End users: What you ship reaches end users through 1.2B+ emails every month.

• Volume: 40M+ emails a day flow through the systems you'll own, so a 1% gain in reliability or deliverability affects hundreds of thousands of emails daily.

• Blast radius: One change can affect every business on the platform at once, which is why we care so much about reliability, data integrity and security.

How we work

• Iterate fast: Go from idea to prototype to production in days, not quarters. Ship small, measure, learn and improve.

• Use AI well: Use AI across the whole cycle (design, coding, testing, reviews and debugging) to move faster without lowering the quality bar, and pick the right model for each job based on quality, latency and cost.

title: Field Marketing Specialist
description:
Field Marketing Specialist
Good Boy Vodka ✅ Remote - Texas Territory ✅ $65,000 - $75,000 Annual Salary ✅ Full Benefits Package ✅ Significant Territory Travel Required
Join One of the Fastest-Growing Beverage Brands
Good Boy Vodka is looking for an energetic, organized, and relationship-driven Field Marketing Specialist to bring our brand to life across Texas and the Western region. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love planning events, building partnerships, coordinating marketing campaigns, and engaging with consumers, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
This role serves as the key marketing contact for the assigned territory, partnering closely with Sales, distributors, brand ambassadors, retailers, event organizers, and venue partners to execute impactful marketing programs that grow brand awareness and drive sales.
What You'll Do
Regional Marketing & Trade Support
Serve as the primary regional marketing contact for distributors and sales teams. Execute national marketing campaigns at the local market level. Build and maintain a regional marketing calendar. Support retail and on-premise promotions, activations, and trade programs. Identify local opportunities that increase consumer engagement and distribution. Events & Sponsorships
Plan and coordinate sampling events, sponsorships, festivals, golf tournaments, venue activations, and community events. Manage event logistics, staffing, promotional materials, permits, and product coordination. Ensure flawless execution of brand experiences. Track event performance and provide recap reporting. Brand Ambassador Coordination
Support scheduling, communication, training logistics, and deployment of regional brand ambassadors. Ensure teams are prepared and equipped for successful activations. Partner with Sales to maximize consumer engagement opportunities. Marketing Operations
Coordinate production and installation of marketing materials including banners, signage, displays, menus, promotional items, and branded assets. Manage vendor relationships, quotes, timelines, and project completion. Track marketing budgets, invoices, expenses, and inventory. Relationship Building
Develop strong partnerships with distributors, retailers, venue operators, and local organizations. Represent Good Boy Vodka at industry events and key meetings. Identify new sponsorship, activation, and partnership opportunities that align with company goals.
What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field preferred. 3+ years of experience in beverage alcohol, consumer goods (CPG), event marketing, trade marketing, field marketing, or brand marketing. Strong project management and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities. Self-starter with a hands-on mentality and problem-solving mindset. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. Ability to travel approximately 30-40%, including evenings and weekends as needed for events.
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive salary: $65,000 - $75,000 anually Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Paid Time Off (PTO) Additional comprehensive employee benefits Opportunity to represent and grow an exciting consumer brand Dynamic, entrepreneurial, and collaborative culture
Why Join Good Boy Vodka?
This is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact on a growing national brand. You'll have the chance to work closely with marketing and sales leadership, execute high-visibility events, build valuable industry relationships, and help shape the consumer experience across your territory.
Apply today and help bring Good Boy Vodka to consumers across Texas and beyond!

title: ROI Clerk (Release of Information)
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re exploring opportunities with us. Below you’ll find details about the role, the impact you can make, and what we’re looking for in an ideal candidate. We’re passionate about building a team that shares our values and brings diverse perspectives to help us grow and succeed together.

Join Our Team at Ternium - A Leading Advocate in Healthcare Revenue Cycle Solutions!  

Are you ready to make a real impact on the healthcare industry? Ternium RCM is seeking a ROI Clerk to help us empower hospitals and health systems across the country. If you're detail-oriented, organized, and passionate about supporting healthcare operations, this is your opportunity to join a growing, innovative team.

Who We Are

At Ternium RCM, we specialize in resolving complex healthcare insurance claim denials and delays. Our mission is to empower hospitals and health systems by optimizing their revenue cycle, allowing them to focus on what matters most-patient care. With a dedicated team of professionals, we consistently deliver outstanding results, increasing net patient revenue, improving cash flow, and reducing operational costs while enhancing the patient experience.

What You’ll Do

As an ROI Clerk (Release of Information) at Ternium RCM, you’ll play an important role in supporting our legal team by obtaining and organizing medical records needed to pursue healthcare insurance claim denials and disputes. This position requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a commitment to handling confidential information accurately and securely.

Key Responsibilities

• Request, retrieve, and obtain medical records from hospitals, healthcare providers, and other designated sources to support attorney case preparation.

• Review requests and documentation to ensure the appropriate medical records are obtained for each case.

• Follow up with healthcare facilities and medical records departments regarding outstanding requests.

• Track and document record requests, receipt dates, and outstanding items to ensure timely completion.

• Organize, label, and maintain electronic medical records and supporting documentation for attorney review.

• Verify records for completeness and accuracy, identifying missing or incomplete documentation and requesting additional information as needed.

• Maintain the confidentiality and security of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.

What You Bring to the Table

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Previous experience in medical records, release of information (ROI), healthcare administration, medical billing, or a related field preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to follow up professionally with healthcare providers.

• Basic computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic document management systems.

• Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and work independently in a remote environment.

Why Join Us?

• Flexible Work Style: Work from anywhere within the United States while making a tangible difference in healthcare.

• Competitive Pay: $15.00 per hour, commensurate with experience.

• Robust Benefits Package: 401(k) with corporate match and comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

• Work-Life Balance: Flexible schedule and paid time off.

• Career Growth: Access to professional development, mentorship, and advancement opportunities within a growing company.

• Additional Perks: Life insurance and performance-based bonuses.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're detail-oriented, enjoy working with documentation, and want to contribute to a purpose-driven healthcare organization, we want to hear from you

title: Merchandise Coordinator - Amazon
description:
Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing !
Position: Merchandise Coordinator - Amazon
Work setup: Work from home
Why join MicroSourcing ?
You'll have:

• Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses

• A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.

• Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.

• Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

• Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Your role:
The Merchandise Coordinator - Amazon keeps our brand partners' Amazon catalogs accurate, complete and selling. This role executes the day-to-day merchandising work across Seller Central (3P) and Vendor Central (1P): launching new products, building enhanced listing content, keeping live listings healthy, and resolving catalog errors and support cases quickly.
The Coordinator follows BrandJump's Marketplace SOP - Amazon & 3P closely, works from the Amazon Records as the source of truth, and partners with the Marketplace Manager, Brand Managers, Brand Content Managers and our 3P team so every load reaches the site correctly and on time. Prior hands-on Amazon experience is required. It is an execution-focused role for someone who is meticulous, organized, comfortable in large spreadsheets and portals, and who enjoys solving the puzzle when Amazon rejects a file or suppresses a listing.
Duties & Responsibilities
Product Launches & Catalog Setup

• Launch new products on Amazon through flat-file templates, Seller Central / Vendor Central portals and the PIM (RiverSand / Syndigo), making sure every requirement is met before submission

• Build and maintain parent/child variation families so sizes, finishes and colors sit together on one detail page

• Create ASINs and pass them to the 3P team (Belami, ShopFreely, Cymax) through ClickUp when the Amazon Record shows authorized 3P sellers

• Know the difference between our 1P (Vendor Central) and 3P (Seller Central) accounts, and follow the right load path for each brand as noted in the Amazon Record

• Keep the Amazon Record and ClickUp tasks current so the team always sees accurate status

Listing Content

• Generate enhanced listing content for 100% of new SKUs (Amazon-direct and 3P) using our Amazon enhanced-content skill in Claude, then review it against the Content QA checklist before it goes on the template

• Follow our Amazon file house rules so listings aren't rejected or suppressed: no HTML in descriptions, no warranty language in bullets, backend search terms under 240 bytes with no repeated words, and consistent wording across a product family

• Optimize live listings above the fold (titles, bullets, images) as part of catalog-health projects, including Vendor Central clean-ups such as removing model numbers from 1P titles

• Upload A+ Content and load assets into Amazon Brand Store modules once creative is approved, and clear basic image or system errors

Catalog Health & Troubleshooting

• Monitor listing health daily: suppressed, inactive, stranded and non-buyable listings, with priority on inactive items that still have inventory

• Read and resolve Amazon error codes and flat-file processing reports, re-submitting corrected files

• Open, track and follow up on Seller Support and Vendor Central cases, logging case IDs in our trackers and escalating to the Marketplace Manager when a case stalls

• Flag catalog-contribution and brand-authority issues (for example, legacy 1P data overriding our updates) so the Marketplace Manager can work them through Brand Registry

• Run listings, imagery and data audits against the brand's data file and the live detail page, and fix
